archetype: Archetype 1: Organic & Earthy (Modified for 'Polished Pink Flamingo' Editorial/Luxury vibe)
design_philosophy: A highly polished, editorial, and dignified charity platform. Avoid kitsch and cartoonish motifs; instead, rely on fine-art textures (flamingo feathers), soft organic hues, and elegant serif typography. The vibe is luxurious compassion—dignified, welcoming, and rooted in the Australian coastal context of Fremantle/Walyalup.

hierarchy.h2: text-3xl sm:text-4xl lg:text-5xl font-light tracking-tight text-deep_plum
hierarchy.overline: text-xs sm:text-sm uppercase tracking-[0.2em] font-semibold text-accent_flamingo

layout_and_spacing.spacing_scale: Generous spacing. Sections should use py-24 or py-32. Cards should use p-8 or p-12.
layout_and_spacing.bento_grid: Use asymmetrical grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-12 gap-8 for the Impact and 'What We Do' sections.

buttons.primary: rounded-full bg-brand-primary text-white px-8 py-4 font-medium transition-transform hover:-translate-y-1 hover:bg-brand-primary_hover hover:shadow-lg
buttons.secondary: rounded-full border border-surface-border bg-transparent px-8 py-4 font-medium text-text-primary transition-all hover:border-brand-primary hover:text-brand-primary

cards.style: bg-surface-card rounded-3xl border border-surface-border/50 shadow-sm transition-all hover:shadow-md p-8 md:p-10

hero_background.description: Abstract extreme close-up of a pink flamingo feather, soft natural lighting, elegant blush hues (AI Generated)
hero_background.placement: Hero section background (with warm white/blush gradient overlay bg-white/40 to ensure text legibility)

community_lunch.description: Polished editorial photograph of a long communal dining table set outdoors (AI Generated)
community_lunch.placement: Friday Lunchies section or About section

fremantle_sunset.description: Stunning sunset view with pathway and rocks along the coast in South Fremantle
fremantle_sunset.placement: Background for 'Acknowledgement of Country' or footer

food_gathering.description: Friends enjoying a picnic with guitar

flamingo_motif.description: Close up of pink flamingo feathers
flamingo_motif.placement: Texture accent in sidebars or bento grid fillers

icons.style: Use thin stroke-width (1.5) for an elegant, non-clunky appearance.

page_structure.1_header: Sticky crystal glass nav. Left: 'Community of Kindness' elegant logotype. Right: Facebook Icon, 'Donate' CTA button.
page_structure.2_hero: Split layout or large overlay. Headline: 'Dignity, Connection, and a Place at the Table.' Subheadline mission statement. CTAs: 'Donate via GoFundMe' and 'Join us on Facebook'. Background: AI flamingo feather abstract with soft overlay.
page_structure.3_acknowledgement: Slim elegant banner or section: 'We acknowledge the Whadjuk Noongar people, traditional custodians of the Walyalup area...'
page_structure.4_about_freya: Editorial split section. Story of Freya Cheffers and the genesis of the Friday Lunchies. Use the community_lunch image here.
page_structure.5_friday_lunchies: Bento grid detailing what the initiative does for rough sleepers in Fremantle. High quality cards with generous padding.
page_structure.6_impact: Large serif numbers in a horizontal layout. (e.g. Meals Served, Community Members Reached).
page_structure.7_gallery_testimonials: Masonry gallery of community food sharing images paired with pull quotes in italic serif.
page_structure.8_how_to_help: 3 columns: Volunteer, Donate (GoFundMe), Share (Facebook). Use soft card surfaces.
page_structure.9_footer: Deep plum or warm blush background. Newsletter signup ('Join our community'), external links, contact info.

interactions_and_motion.hover: Subtle Y-axis translation (-translate-y-1) and elegant shadow scaling.
interactions_and_motion.scroll: Fade up and staggered entrance for bento grids and gallery images using framer-motion.
interactions_and_motion.accessibility: Ensure contrast on all text. All buttons must have data-testid attributes.

instructions_to_main_agent: Install required fonts from Google Fonts: Cormorant Garamond and Outfit.
Use pure HTML/Tailwind for marketing layout structures; avoid Shadcn generic cards if they constrain the bento grid or padding rules.
Do not use generic blue/indigo default colors. Strictly adhere to the blush/coral/plum palette.
Ensure 'GoFundMe' and 'Facebook' CTAs are highly visible and styled beautifully, not as generic tech buttons.
Create a polished, editorial feel. Never use a literal vector cartoon flamingo. Rely on the abstract textures and colors to convey the theme.
